tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rje btsun rngon pa'i gdams ngag las 'byung ba rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs bde ba sbyin pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /rje btsun rngon pa'i gdams ngag las 'byung ba rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs bde ba sbyin pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun rngon pa'i gdams ngag las 'byung ba rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs bde ba sbyin pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ bde mchog dpa' bo'i longs spyod rdzogs gsal ba/ khams gsum rgyal ma dmar ba'i 'od chags sku/ /glog phran ltar g.yo gnyen lcug 'khril ldem ma/ /bcu drug lang tsho'i dpal ldan la phyag 'tshal/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i zlos gar ni/ /'chi med na chung sgyu ma'i 'jo sgeg can/ /mtshar sdug 'od kyi phyogs cha rnams 'gengs ma'i/ skur ston rgyal ba'i yum gcig bcom ldan ma/ /'char ka gsar ba'i 'od ris 'chang ldan bde bas myong ba'i bag yangs ma/ / gzhom med dhu ti'i glu dbyangs rna ba'i bcud len rab sbyor chu skyes dbang*/ /rab rgyas mchog tu bzhad pa'i ze'u 'bru'i so 'phreng gsal mdzes ngom pa 'di/ /bdag yid rkang drug gzhon nu lhan skyes sbrang chang gis myos rol bar mdzod/ /'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal rlabs phreng g.yo ba'i chu rlung de yis/ / bde chen yongs 'du 'bras bur smin pa'i dpal yon bzang pos/ /bdag sems gzhon nu ring du dub pa ngal bso'i bsti nas/ /gnyug ma'i lus kyi bskyed tshal brgyan par mdzod cig /ka ye/ rab chags lag pa'i 'khri shing phyag rgyar 'khyud/ /rab bde ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi 'jib byed pa/ /rnam kun rtse 'jo'i rol ba'i dpa' bo bzhin/ /bdag kyang bdag po'i gnas la 'god par mdzod/ /rje btsun rngon pa'i gdams ngag las 'byung ba bzhin badzra wa rā hī sgrub par 'dod pas/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bde ba'i stan la gdong byang ngam nub tu phyogs pas/ dang por phyogs skyong rnams la gtor ma phul la/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bla ma'i maṇḍal dang*/ yi ge brgya pa'i bsgom bzlas ci srid mtshan ma ma thob kyi bar du bya'o/ /bla ma'i maṇḍal gzhan du shes la/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma ni 'og nas 'byung ngo*/ /mi shes sam mi spro na ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon med do/ /de nas phyis bsnyen pa'i skabs su ni skyabs sems sngon du btang ste/

añtsa mā naṃ gyi kha dag pa sngon du 'gro bas rang gi spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can la/ spro na 'dir yang bla ma'i maṇḍal byed/ oṃ āḥshrī mansaṅgu ru tsa rā ṇa ka ma lā ya/ saṃmyakdzña na bha sa na ka rā ya na maste hūṃ/ mos pa drag pos phyag byas la/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dzña na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ thod pa'i nang gi myos byed sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ rtsa sngags brjod cing chos 'byung bri < oṃbaṃ.āḥhūṃ > oṃ ā hūṃ baṃ zur gsum dang lte bar dgod/ sor mo bcus ma da na blangs la/ sor bcu bsnol ba spyi bo nas rkang pa'i bar du reg pas khrus dang*/ bsrung ba bya ste oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes bzlas brjod bya'o/ /de nas/ g.yon gyi mtheb mdzub gung srin mthe'u chung rgyab rnams su padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rim pas/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hrīṃ moṃ/ hreṃ hriṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ lha mo drug gi ngo bo/ oṃ badzra puṣpe ā hūṃ gis re re bzhin me tog phul/ oṃ a hūṃ gis nang mchod phul/ de zhu zhing thim pa gnas drug tu srung zhing thim par bsam mo/ / mdun du sa gzhi dag pa la/ bdud rtsis chos 'byung sor gsum pa bris pa'i dbus su baṃ de la ka ra bī ra la sogs pa'i me tog dmar po mchod/ de'i steng du ka pā la bdud rtsis bkang ba/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bdug pas bdug par bya'o/ /me long dag pa la sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor byas la < hāhriḥbaṃ > tshad med bzhi bsgoms par bya ste/ de nas 'og nas 'byung ba ltar dag pa gsum dran par bya'o/ / lte ba'i chos 'byung sngags 'phreng sa bon dang bcas pa'i 'od 'phreng dang mdun gyi sngags kyi 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo rdo rje rol pa mo sa gsum na bzhugs pa thams cad dang*/ rang bzhin gyi grub pa thams cad phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dgug gzhugs bcing mnyes bya'o/

/ lha mo sngags kyi gzugs brnyan sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor spro ba/ hūṃ aḥ rdo rje dang dril bu bzung*/ sumbha lan bdun gyis sngags pa'i bsang chus/ oṃ āḥkhanḍa ro he sarba bighna nu sā ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ las byung ba'-i mchod rdzas rnams su gyur/ sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ nas nai wi tya 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar nang mchod byin rlabs rgyas bsdus gang rung byas la/ sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btab pas mchod/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod cing*/ spro na/ rlung gis bskyod pas 'og gi 'khor lo nas bzhengs glog gi zer ltar 'od gsal zhing*/ /rtsibs can gsum po bsregs nas 'jig rten gsum gyis mchod gyur bdud rtsi'i rgyun rab gsal/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bcud dang 'dres shing skyon bral shin tu kun dga'i tshogs ster ba/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam dbye bral ba rdo rje phag mos 'gro 'di srungs/ /mu tig gis spras byi ru'i chun po ltar gsal skar bcas dgong kha'i thun mtshams 'dra/ /me stag rab 'phro 'jigs byed me 'bar lta bur phyogs dang nam mkha' gsal byed cing*/ /me tog dkar po dang ldan kaṃ shu ka yi me tog 'bar ba'i tshogs 'dra ba/ /gzi brjid du mas rnam brgyan dmar ba'i sku mnga' rdo rje phag mos khyed la srungs/ / he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ de nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / zhes sogs yan lag bdun pa bya/ ka sogs yi ges skor te sprul pa'i rtsibs can nyi dbang dkyil 'khor la bzhugs shing*/ /'bar ba'i me ltar rab 'bar bdud rtsi 'dzag pa padma'i skud pa ltar phra ba/ /rig ma sangs rgyas tshogs rnams bsreg cing 'khor lo gsum po byed pa gang yin pa/ /kun dga' dang bcas rol ba gyen gshegs phag mo bdag gi sems la gsal gyur cig/dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rang gi snying gar sngags kyi dkyil 'khor thim par bsam/

lha mo tshad ma sogs 'don/ tshad med bzhi sgom par bya'o/ /de nas klu'i 'dug stangs sam/ min na skyil krung 'cha'/ brla g.yas dang g.yon/ dpung pa g.yon pa rnams su thal mo brdab pa'i sgra byed cing*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sogs dang*/ oṃ badzra shuddha sarba dharma badzra shuddho3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shuddha sarba dharma yo ga shuddho3haṃ/ dag pa gsum dran pa'o/ /de nas stong pa nyid sgom zhing*/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dzña na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ oṃ a ni mi ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ oṃ a pra ṇi hi ta dzña na badzra swa bhā wā atma ko3haṃ/ de'i tshe dbugs phyi rol tu bkag go / de nas rngub pa dang mnyam du sgyu ma lta bur dran pas/ rang sems hriḥde las 'od zer 'phros/ gdug pa thams cad tshar bcad/ oṃ hri gha gha gha tā ya gha tā ya sarba duṣtaṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ las rdo rje gur dang ra ba dang sa gzhi dang me dpung 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ srung 'khor gyis dbus su sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa las/ lha mo sku mdog dkar mo de'i bha ga las 'od 'phros pas spyan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa rdo rje sems dpa' he ru kas bcom ldan 'das ma la 'khyud cing rdo rje bde ba chen po'i dam tshig gis snyoms par zhugs/ rang gi rnam shes rlung dang bcas pa baṃ yig gi rnam pas sbyor mtshams su zhugs nor bu'i thig le dkar po la thim/ de shes rab ma'i rdul la thim pas yab yum bde ba chen po'i ngo bor zhu nas thig ler gyur/ de las bha ga chos 'byung gru gsum gdengs ga gyen du bstan pa/ phyi rol dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi dang bcas pa phyi rol dur khrod dang srung ba'i 'khor los bskor bar gyur/ hūṃ zhes pa'i sgras thig le de nyid cha gsum du gyur pa'i 'og ma nyi ma/ bar ma zla ba/ steng ma baṃ las rdo rje/ de rnams 'dres pa las sku yongs su rdzogs par bzhengs te/

pad nyi'i gdan la/ rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje phag mo li khri'i mdangs ldan/ thun mtshams kyi sprin ltar dmar ser rnam par 'gyur ba'i bzhin/ rtsa zhal shin tu mdzes shing lhag par chags pas 'dzum zhing bzhad pa/ mche ba'i myu gu gtsigs shing yid tsam khro ba/ dmar shing bkra la rab tu g.yo ba'i spyan gnyis zur mig tu blta zhing*/ spyan dbus ma g.yo ba med par gyen du gzigs pa/ bung ba ltar gnag pa'i skra tshogs phyed ltag par bcings/ phyed sil bur grol bas sku stod khyab pa la me tog gi phreng ba mdzes pa/ snyan g.yas pa'i rgyab tu phag zhal mthing ga khro zhing 'khrug pa/ mche ba bzang ring can/ gyen du phyogs shing hūṃ sgra sgrog la rna ba 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas dang po gri gug thur du sdigs pa/ gnyis pas cang te steng du khrol ba/ g.yon dang pos thod pa zla ba dang me tog gi rgyun gyis gang ba bsnams nas gsol ba/ gnyis pa rtse gsum 'og tu bsnun pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yon brkyang gis skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs mdzad pa/ gcer mo brgyad gnyis lon pa ltar lang tsho bdo ba/ sku sha rgyas shing 'jam la mnyen lcug gi lus can ma/ rab tu chags pas padma bzhad pa'i ze'u 'bru 'od phreng 'khrug pa/ nu ma mtho zlum mdzes shing sked skabs phra bas gsum 'khyog gi gar stabs kyi ldem skyog can/ nyi ma bcu gnyis las lhag pa'i gzi brjid 'bar zhing*/ rang thabs kha ṭwāṃ ga dkar po mchan khung du gnas pa la 'khyud pas yan lag dang 'dus pa/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bu mo padma can gyis rnam pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang*/ 'dzag pa'i mgo bo brgya phyed kyi do shal can/ kunda ltar dkar ba'i thod skam lnga'i cod pan dang*/ rus 'phreng sil sil gyis skra mtshams rgyas par brgyan pa/ mi ro'i steng na gar mdzad pas/ 'bar zhing g.yo ba'i bskal ba'i me'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ sprul pa mtha' yas pa spros shing sdud pa'i sngags 'chang ma/ de'i lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/

snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hreṃ hriṃ ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ hūṃ ljang khu skrag byed ma/ tshigs thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsiṇḍa ga'i rang bzhin/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las lha mo drug po gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa'o/ /oṃ wā rā hī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ yā mī ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ mo ha nī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sañtsa lī nī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sant+ra sā nī hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsaṇḍi kā hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ dpral bar 'khor lo la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par padma la āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma la hūṃ sngon po/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ phaiṃ/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro ma'i bskor ba spyan drangs mdun du bzhugs pa la/ arghaṃ sogs dang*/ nang mchod kyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bstod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ 'khyud rgya dang bcas/ oṃ yo ga shuddha sarba dharma yo ga shuddho3haṃ/ dbang gi lha dpal he ru kas rdo rje rin po che'i bum pas dbang bskur/ oṃ badzra bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ dri ma thams cad dag spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ aṃ praṃ aṃ pāṃ puṃ dhuṃ tsuṃ aṃ baṃ gaṃ tīṃ naṃ laṃ bruṃ shaṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes mchod pa'i gzungs ma rnams phyir phyung nas mchod par gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin/ prokṣa naṃ/ añtsa ma naṃ/ pādyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ dī pe/ tsurṇa/ wāstaṃ/ ghandhaṃ/ tī laṃ/ ne wī dyaṃ/ laṃ ba naṃ/ gṛ haṃ/ u dya naṃ/ oṃ gī tī/ nirti/ shapta āḥhūṃ/ de nas sgo mtshams ma brgyad gri thod ḍā ma ru/ kha ṭwāṃ ga thogs pa ljang khu rnams kyis bstod par bsam shing*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lor bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes/ / 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/

/ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*/ /'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug dang*/ /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /rnam par rtog med yang dag rtog /yid ni rab tu mi gnas pa/ /yid la med cing bsam pa med/ / dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ khams gsum pa yi ngo bo nyid/ /bskal ba'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ / zhes bstod/ de nas/ lte ba dang spyi bo dang*/ de nas phag gdong gi dpral ba'i bar du dhū tī dmar po mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa lte ba nas ze 'bru'i bar du bya gdong dkar zhing phra ba/ lte ba'i nang du chos 'byung gi dbus su hrīḥ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sngags 'phreng tshan pa gsum du bkod pa dang*/ dga' 'khyil bzhi dang bcas pa/ phag gdong gi smin mtshams su zla ba la baṃ/ bya gdong gi rtser nyi ma la baṃ/ yi ge rnams las steng 'og tu 'od sbu gu lta bu 'phros/ sna bug g.yon dang bya gdong las byung*/ 'jig rten gsum gyi bud med rnams kyi spyi bo dang*/ kha ga mu kha las khu rdul dang*/ skyes bu'i spyi bo dang*/ shaṃ kha las khu ba drangs te/ nyi zla gnyis dang 'dres/ de thams cad steng 'og nas sngags phreng la thim/ thams cad bya gdong gi khar byon pa la rtse gcig tu dmigs shing bde bas myos pas 'dar g.yo ba la bsam nas sngags bzla/ dmigs pa de yang yang gsal btab yang 'khor lo gru gsum g.yon skor du bar med du 'khor ba/ 'od zer spro bsdu'i bdag nyid du mos la/ thur sel drangs shing rtse gcig tu sgom/ skyon sngags bzla'o/ / oṃ badzra wā rā hī a be sha ya āḥ sarba duṣtaṃ hriḥswāhā/ snying po'o/ / oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba budha ḍā ki ni sogs ni rtsa sngags so/ /

oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ nye snying ngo*/ / oṃ hrīḥbaṃ phaiṃ āḥhūṃ/ shin tu nye snying po'o/ / oṃ badzra wā rā hī dzñā na a be sha ya āḥ.āḥhrī swāhā/ ye shes dbab pa'i sngags so/ / de nas 'gog pa'i bzlas pa dang*/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa rnam pa gnyis ka'ang spro na bya'o/ /thun mtshams la 'jug pa'i tshe rab gnas dang*/ 'khor dang sprul pa thams cad sgyu ma lta bur bsam/ rang bzhin gyis dag pa swa bhā wa sogs gsum brjod de/ rjes gzhig gis bsdus la/ slar yang skad cig gis lha mo langs te/ dag pa rdo rje gsum dran par byas te thun mtshams la 'jug go /mdor bsdu na gzhung gi dngos bstan gyi chog go ces kho bos smra'o/ /thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ zan dang chang dang byi skyu sogs las gtor ma bya/ sum bhā sa bsangs/ swa bhā wā sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ oṃ āḥhūṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum/ a las ka pā la/ de'i nang du/ hūṃ bruṃ aṃ dzriṃ khaṃ las sha lnga/ baṃ maṃ laṃ paṃ taṃ las bdud rtsi lnga/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas bcu zhu ba nyi ma'i kha dog can/ nam mkhar kha ṭwāṃ ga mgo bo thur du stan pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ de zhu nas

rdzas la thim/ oṃ a āḥ.i ī nas / hakṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa rnams zhu ba oṃ āḥhūṃ du gyur/ de'i 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byang chub sems bdud rtsir spyan drangs te/ yi ge 'bru gsum dang bcas pa la thim/ de yang gtor ma la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho zad mi shes par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ mdun bskyed med na skabs 'dir/ phaiṃ nas/ yo ga shuddha sogs kyi bar gong bzhin/ ljags hūṃ las rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i 'od kyi sbu gus drangs te gsol bar bsam/ padma'i skor bas/ phaiṃ/ oṃ badzra a ralli ho dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ dri shya ho zhes lan bdun kyis dbul/ arghaṃ sogs dang*/ nang mchod dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dpal 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma zhes sogs brjod/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam par sogs bya/ de nas/ phaiṃ/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba yakṣa rakṣa sa sogs dang*/ arghaṃ sogs dang*/ nang mchod dang*/ lha yi tshogs rnams sogs spyi dang mthun par bya ste 'jig rten pa la 'bul ba'o/ /de nas las kyi mkha' 'gro ma rje btsun ma dang 'jig rten pa phaiṃ/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī e maṃ bā liṃ gṛhna gṛhna ha ha ha ha kha kha kha kha/ a a a a ma ma siddhi me pra yatstsha hūṃ phaṭa swāhā zhes rje btsun ma dang*/ oṃ hriḥhaṃ hāṃ haḥhāḥhiḥhīḥphaiṃ phaiṃ/ zhes 'jig rten pa la 'bul lo/ /de nas yang mchod bstod dngos grub blangs yi ge brgya pa brjod/ gshegs su gsol ba ste/ de yang gatstsha gatstsha swa sthā naṃ/ zhes 'jig rten pa rnams gshegs su gsol/ oṃ yo ga shuddha sogs kyi ye shes pa rang la bsdu'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ / yang phyi rol mchod pa bsdus pa ni/ phaiṃ gyis spyan drangs nas/ yo ga shuddha 'i bar bya/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes mchod pa rnams yid kyi byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ ḍi ya pu li rā ma gi ri ka maṃ khyaṃ shrī hāṭṭa dharma saṃ bho ga nirma ṇa mahā su kha kā ya zhes bstod/

oṃ badzra yo gi ni puṣpe dhu paṃ dī paṃ gandhaṃ bā liṃ gṛhna gṛhna ma ma rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes mchod gtor chabs gcig tu 'bul/ rjes gtor chog ltar bya'o/ /'di ni yid kyi bsam pa kho na yin gyi rdzas dang yo byad med kyang chog go /bya rog gi gtor ma'i sngags ni/ oṃ klaṃ klaṃ klaṃ dharma tā/ ā kā sha tsā ri ṇaḥsiddhi dā yi naḥ kaṃ bāṃ yaṃ shaṃ pa la siddhi kā ga santā na/ pra sū trā/ kā ka ba liṃ/ gṛhna tu klaṃ klaṃ klaṃ swāhā/ chu gnas kyi sems can la ni/ oṃ shlaṃ shlaṃ shlaṃ a pra tiṣṭha tsā la tsa ri ṇaḥshya ma sha ma la siddhi shu na ka /saṃ ta na dzā shu na kā bā liṃ gṛhnantu klaṃ klaṃ klaṃ swāhā/ khyi la sogs pa sa la rgyu ba spyi la/ oṃ bhrim bhrim bhrim shu n+ya tā/ da shā shā tsā ri ṇaḥni saṃ ba lā/ siddha bhū ta go ta dzū ni/ bhū ta ni bā liṃ gṛhna tu gṛhna tu bhriṃ bhriṃ bhriṃ swāhā/ lce spyang gi gtor ma la/ oṃ hroṃ hroṃ hroṃ phaṭe kla ra kla rī ṇa ku la pra sū ta si pa/ hi li hi li ba liṃ gṛhna tu/ sarba siddhi m/ da dantu da dantu hroṃ hroṃ hroṃ swāhā/ de yang tshes bcu la sogs pa la thog mar rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma gtor ma dang banbhu sogs me tog dmar pos mchod/ de nas bya rog la sogs de dag yid kyis bsangs sbyangs/ sa bon las lhar bskyed/ phaiṃ/ gyi ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur rgyas btab yid kyis mdor bsdus su byas la/ lag g.yas nam mkhar rdo rje sdig 'dzub bya/ gtor ma/ til dang*/ nas dang*/ sha chen dang mar sres pa/ yid kyis byin gyis brlabs nas sngags brjod cing*/ lag g.yon pas sbyin/ ltas brtag/yig brgya brjod de bzod par gsol/ gshegs su gsol te bkra shis bya'o/ /bsnyen pa'i skabs ci rigs dang*/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa rgyas bsdus gang byed rung*/ sku gzugs kyi drung du sha chen gyi spos 'bul ba'i sngags ni/

oṃ āḥhriṃ hūṃ hūṃ haḥhaḥ nyer gcig brjod do/ /de ltar na gtor ma'i cho ga'o/ /gzhon nu ma'i mchod pa ni/ bu mo gzhon nu ma skye gnas ma nyams pa sum cu rtsa bdun nam/ bcu gsum mam/ drug gam/ lnga'am/ gcig kyang rung*/ yan lag ma nyams pa/ rab sngags kyi spyod pa can/ 'bring dbang bskur ba/ tha ma dbang ma thob pas kyang rung*/ dam tshig nyams pa'i ni ye nas mi btub pa'i de la brtag dgos/ gal te skye gnas ma nyams pa ma brnyes na/ bu ma btsas pa bzung ngo*/ /gal te de yi ma btub na/ khye'u 'am/ rigs so drug gi bu mo'i gzugs brnyan gyis kyang chog tsam yin gsung*/ gang ltar nyi ma dang po la phyi rol mchod pa rgyas par bya/ gzhon nu ma rnams la snyan mnan/ nangs par phyi rol mchod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung bya/ gzhon nu ma rnams dbang thob na dkyil 'khor khang par 'jug /ma thob na phyi rol lam yol bas bcad/ de yang rang gi gnyis ka mthong bar byed/ cho ga ni sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ gnas dang mchod pa byin dbab/ bu mo rnams bsangs sbyangs nas/ bskyed chog mdun bskyed ji lta bar byed/ so bdun yod na lha so bdun du bskyed/ de bzhin du grangs bzhin du bcu gsum ma dang*/ go cha drug gis bskor ba'i bdun ma dang*/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi yis bskor ba'i snga ma dang*/ gtso mo rkyang ba bskyed/ gtor ma'i bar mdun bskyed dang 'dra/ tshogs mchod bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/ bza' bcas sna tshogs sbyin/ bar chad srung ba'i sngags bzlas shing*/ ltas brtag /lhag gtor btang*/ bkra shis brjod pa'i bar rjes chog kyang 'dra ba las mchod pa'i skabs/ so rtsi dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ btung ba'i khyad par sbyin par bya gsung ngo*/ /de nas sbyin sreg sngags kyi bcu cha las mi nyung bas lha mnyes par bya ste/ de'i cho ga ni gzhan tu shes par bya'o/ /de nas sgrub pa ni dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'am/ me long gi dkyil 'khor 'og nas 'byung ba ltar byas nas/

bdag mdun chabs gcig tu byas nas sgrub pa/ zla ba phyed dam/ zla ba gcig gam/ zla ba drug tu bya'o/ /de nas yang yang bskul tshig gi sngags dang*/ sbyor ba drag pos bsgrubs pas grub par 'gyur ste/ de nas ni las dang dngos grub thogs med du 'grub gsung*/ de nas phyi rol mchod pa ni 'grub na rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ ji ltar 'khor lo sdom pa'i cho ga bzhin te/ 'dir sta gon ni mi byed/ gzhan sa chog nas bzung rdzogs par bya gsung*/ de tsam ma grub na/ gzhal med khang rdzogs pa mtha' ma nyi ma tsam bri/ dbus su nyi ma la chos 'byung bya ste/ de yang ma grub na bsdus pa chu tshon gyis bri bar bya ste/ da ltar 'di la phyag bzhes gtso bor mdzad do/ /dkyil 'khor dkar po gru bzhi pa'i dbus su ljang khu/ zlum po de'i dbus su chos 'byung dmar po/ phyi rol tu dga' 'khyil bzhi/ dbus su baṃ phyogs bzhir las bzhi'i maṇḍal/ yang maṇḍal ljang khu gnyis/ bum pa sgrub na maṇḍal ljang khu dang*/ dbus su dkar po/ der me tog sna tshogs bgram ste lag len bzhin bya'o/ /dbus su sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du'am/ mañdzi la ka pā la chang dang bdud rtsis bkang ba bzhag/de nas me long dag pa la/ gzhon nu ma'i mtshal gyi spags pa'i ras dmar po la sindhu ra rtsags te dgram/ gser gyi smyug gu mtheb srin gyis bzung nas lag len bzhin 'dri/ de nas sngon 'gro'i gtor ma 'bul de/ suṃ bha sa bsangs/ swabha wa sa sbyangs / oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hriḥ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la ā karṣa ya dzaḥ padma ka ma la ya staṃ/ oṃ ind+ra ya/ agnā ye sogs kyi mthar pra ba ra saṅka raṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ pā dyaṃ/ añtsa ma naṃ/ prokṣa naṃ/ puṣpe sogs kyis mchod/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis sam bdun gyis phul/ shar phyogs rdo rje gdan gyi lha tshogs sogs kyis gsol ba btab pa'am/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po la sogs la/

/gsang spyod don du gtor ma 'di/ / 'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol/ /suṃ bha sa bgegs skrad/ de nas gnas dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs/ bdag bskyed rdzogs par sgom/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ suṃ ro gcig tu 'dres pa la padma dang nyi ma/ chos 'byung dang bcas pa/ de'i nam mkha' la yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum de la gnas pa'i/ a las ka pā la dum bu gcig pa/ nang du hūṃ bhruṃ nas ha ho hriḥ yi bar gtor chog ltar ro / /de'i steng du hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ gdug pa thams cad tshar bcad/ zhes pa nas/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs ltar ro/ / oṃ pi ṭho pa pi ṭhā ya swā hā/ oṃ kṣe tro pa kṣe trā ya swā hā/ oṃ tshando pa tshandā ya swā hā/ oṃ me la pa ko pa me la kā ya swā hā/ oṃ shma sha ne pa shma sha nā ya swā hā/ oṃ pi la po pa pi la pā ya swā hā/ pu dza o a go ra de ma ka o tri ko ka la ka hi/ pre gro sau su na si ma ku/ hūt brgyad brjod de gnas byin gyis brlabs/ nyi ma'i steng du/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar pa gdengs ka gyen du bstan pa/ phyi rol dga' ba 'khyil ba bzhi dang bcas pa/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba/ chos 'byung dbus su pad nyi la/ baṃ las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun rdo rje phag mo nas/ dbu brgyan gyi bar gong ltar ro/ /rtsa sngags brjod pas / gtso mo dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ rab sngags ma dang*/ rdo rje rnam snang ma dpag tu med par gyur/ oṃ maṃ taṃ baṃ laṃ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ /yum bzhi dang rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa spro ba'i bdag nyid du bsam/

'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang phaiṃ zhes pas las kyi mkha' 'gro dang*/ skye gnas gsum gyi bdag nyid 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba tra byaṃ bi shodha ni hūṃ phaṭa ces pa'am/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs spyi dang mthun pas kyang bya/ de nas mchod pa ni/ thog mar me tog 'bul te/ sngags re re'i mthar oṃ badzra puṣpe sogs sbyar ba ste/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍa ki nī ye badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ badzra barṇa nī ye= /badzra bai ro tsa nī ye= /ḍā ki nī/ lā me/ khanṭa ro he/ rū pī nī/ a ā nas/ aṃ= /oṃ baṃ wā ra hī/ haṃ yoṃ ya mi nā/ hriṃ moṃ ha nī/ hreṃ hriṃ pañtsa nī/ hūṃ hūṃ sant+ra sa nī= /phaṭa phaṭa tsaṇḍi kī= nanda burdha ya= / de'i rjes su chu bzhi dang*/ nyer spyod lnga dang*/ yang dag dga' ba'i me tog gi /sogs dang*/ rin chen bdun dang*/ lha mo bcu drug dang*/ nang mchod dang*/ gsang mchod/ rkang brgyad dang*/ oṃ ḍi ya sogs dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ / sogs dang*/ skye ba dang ni 'jig pa dang bral mchog gi lus can ma/ /dmar ba'i 'od chags rnam par rgyal ma khams gsum gzugs can ma/ /yon tan tshogs kyi brgyan pa'i sku mnga' rdo rje yan lag ma/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi skyed mdzad ma la rtag tu mngon par phyag bgyi'o/ /gang dang gang zhig gshin rje ma dang de nas bcom ldan rmongs byed dus kun skyong byed ma/ /gzhan pa skrag byed ma dang gang yang dri med rnal 'byor ma yi dbang phyug gtum byed ma/ 'khor lo la gnas zhal gcig phyag bzhi sngo dang dkar mo dang ni gser gyi mdog can ma/ /ljang dang du ba dang mtshungs gar byed de rnams zhabs la rang gi mgo bos phyag bgyi'o/ / de nas rnal 'byor ma'i rtsa sngags chen po yang spro na bstod bskul du bya gsungs de'i rjes su gtor ma phul la/ oṃ sarba bhakṣa kā mo nī sarba bhakṣa shodha nī gu hya badzra ṇī kro dhe shwa rī sarba dra byi bya bi ni sho dha ya sho dha ya hūṃ/

bzlas brjod yun ring du byas la/ tshogs la longs spyod de de'i cho ga gzhan du rtogs par bya'o/ /de nas mchod bstod bya/ dngos grub dang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa mang du brjod nas/ sngags dman pa dang cho ga dman/ /bya ba dman par gang gyur pa/ /rab dang mchog gi dngos grub gtso/ /lha mo de dag bzod mdzad rigs/ /srid dang zhi ba sogs dang*/ mnyams pa chags pa dang ni chags pa bcom/ khyod kyis dngos kun rang bzhin nam mkha' dang ni 'drar gzugs kyang*/ /mgon po shin tu lci ba'i thugs rje'i chu rgyas sems la ni/ / mdzod cing lha mo rnams kyi bdag la rjes brtser mdzad du gsol/ /bdag la 'phrin las dang dngos grub thams cad gegs med par stsal ba dang*/ /myur du dpal he ru ka nyid kyi go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ tshul khrims tsa dan gyi lus byugs/ /bsam gtan gyis ni gos dag gyon/ /byang chub yan lag me tog bkram/ /ji ltar bde bar bzhugs su gsol/ /lha mo tshad ma sogs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang la thim/ 'jig rten pa rnams la/ khyod kyis sems can sogs dang*/ oṃ gatstsha gatstsha swa bhā bā naṃ kṛ tante na ta thā gatstsha sarba buddha shtsa bi sardza ya ma ma karmaṃ ku ru swā hā/ a kā ro brjod pas dkyil 'khor dbye/ lte bar oṃ baṃ sogs go cha bgo /snang ba lhar dran bzhin pas/ rdo rje btsun mo 'grub gyur nas sogs dang*/ rigs su skye dang sogs smon lam btab bkra shis bya ste mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'o/ /gal te byin rlabs bya bar 'dod na/ bzlas pa yan chad sngar ltar bya/ de nas bum pa sgrub ste/ sgrub tshul ni spyi dang mthun la mdun bskyed dang bum pa gnyis ka la mchod gtor phyogs gcig tu 'bul ba yod de/ de la ni mdun bskyed bzlas pa grub nas bum pa bskyed cing bzlas nas/ bzhu zin pa la/ mchod pa rgyas pa mdzad pa phyag len yin cing tshad ldan dang 'gal ba'ang med do/

/de nas bdag 'jug ni/ mig dar 'ching ba man chad dang*/ bsdu na ye shes dbab pa man chad mdzad/ bod kyi lag len dang bstun/ maṇḍal 'bul ba nas brtsams te/ slob ma'i bya ba ji lta ba bzhin yang rung bar mngon/ de yang tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i lha dang bla ma mnyes par byas la yon phul te/ sgyu ma'i 'khor lor rnam par 'khor ba rnams/ /skyob mdzad tshig 'bru spangs pa dngos kun rtogs/ /mgon po khyod nu nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ste/ /'gro ba'i skye bo skyob pa khyod kyis skyongs/ / zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab/ sa khams pa la skyes bu'i gzugs bya/ slob ma'i lte bar raṃ/ de'i gdung bas sdig sgrib thams cad sha za'i gzugs kyis gzugs brnyan la thim/ hūṃ las skyes pa'i phur bu/ oṃ gha gha gha tā ya sogs kyis/ phur bus gdab/ oṃ badzra mutga ra sogs kyis tho bas brdung*/ de nyid stong pa'i ngang du thim/

gtor ma gcig la sgron me lnga btsug /slob ma'i dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga lte ba rnams la skor zhing*/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swāhā/ oṃ ka ṭe bi ka ṭe ni ka ṭe kaṃ ṭyaṃ ka ṭe swāhā/ oṃ ghuṭṭa ghuṭṭa ghaṭṭi ni ghuṭṭi ni gha gha gha tā ya gha tā ya swā hā/ oṃ ru ru sphu ru dzwa la tiṣṭha siddhi lo tsa ni artha sā dha ni swā hā/ slob ma 'di'i 'khor lo bzhir gnas nas khams bzhi la gnod pa skyed pa lus ngag sems dang ye shes rdo rje bzhir sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad phyir dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de rnams rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dis tshal ba rgyar dgas par 'gyur ro/ / sumbha dang rol mo sgra bya/ sgron me chur bcug la lam gyi bzhi mdor gtor ma dor/ slob ma'i mgo bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ sumbha bzlas pas srung ngo*/ de nas maṇḍal phul/ de la slob dpon gyi/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ gis me tog gi phon po lag tu gtad/ sngags de nyid kyi mig dar bcing*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis bdud rtsi mgo la gtor/ kha ṭwāṃ ga'i yu ba slob dpon gyi bzung*/ de'i 'gram nas slob mas 'jus te/ snying po bzla zhing nad du khrid/ dur khrod kyi gnas sam/ dga' 'khyil gyi gnas la 'dug par mos su 'jug deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ zhes sogs kyi gsang bar gdams/ oṃ pañtsa a mri to ta ka ṭha ṭhaṭhaḥ 'di ni khyod kyis dmyal ba'i chu/ / zhes sogs kyis dam bzhag dang mna' chu blud/ de nas slob ma phag mor bsgoms pa la/ lte ba la sogs par/ oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo sogs/ sgom du bcug nas/ rdo rjes reg cing*/ oṃ baṃ wā rā hī hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ nas rtsanṭi ka 'i bar brjod/ de nas slob ma lus thang sha bcad pa'i tshul gyi nya bzhi sgrim/ oṃ swa bha ba sogs dag pa gsum dran du bzhug /slob ma'i rkang pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ sum mdo me/

der chos 'byung gru gsum/ dbus su 'bar ba'i klog dang bcas pa/ slob dpon la mos gus dung byas pas/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed dang*/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje phag mo'i rnam pas lte bar sib sib thim/ de'i rkyen gyis de rje btsun rdo rje phag mo'i skur gyur nas bde ba'i gar mdzad pas me lces lus thams cad khyab par 'bar/ spyi bo nas byang sems babs/ bde bas khyab/ lus kyi nang 'od zer sna lngas khrig mer gang*/ chos 'byung mi mngon pa tsam du g.yon du 'khor ba la sems gtod du bzhug cing*/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ slob dpon gyi lag g.yas rdo rje gsor zhing bdug pas bdug / oṃ yaṃ raṃ paṃ laṃ hūṃ badzra bā rā hī a be sha ya āḥ.āḥ.āḥ zhes dang*/ rtsa sngags dang snying po'i mthar gong gi dbab sngags btags pa lan brgya'am ci rigs su bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā dzñā ya tiṣṭha bha bān tu zhes me tog spyi bor bzhag / oṃ tiṣṭha badzra swāhā/ rdo rje rgya khram spyi bor bzhag /de nas me tog traṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i me tog tu mos nas/ rdo rje thig le dngos kun za ma tog /ma lus 'gro la bde ster mig 'phrul lta/ /kun 'gro dpal ldan phag mo chos kun bskyed/ /sgyu 'phrul snyim pa'i me tog bzhes shig ho/ / spro na tiṣṭha badzra ḍi ḍho sogs brjod cing gtor/ bsdu na oṃ pra titstsha badzra hoḥ de nas me tog slob ma'i spyi bor bcings te/ pra ti gṛhna st+waṃ/ i maṃ satwa mahā bā la/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ / sogs dang*/ mig gnyis la 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i oṃ gyi 'od kyis gsal bar bsgom ste gdong g.yog dgrol/ yang na mig dar bcings dgrol mi mdzad pa'ang yod de dngos bstan no/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gsal bar sgom du gzhug /'jug pa rdzogs so/ /maṇḍal phul la/ lha mo sku'i rdo rje ni/ sgyu 'phrul rgyal po phyag 'tshal bstod/

khyod kyi go 'phang mnyam med pa/ /bdag la de ring gnang bar mdzod/ de bzhin du/ lha mo gsung gi= /mi shigs rgya mtsho= khyod kyi= bdag la= /thugs kyi= /bde ba'i = khyod kyi= /bdag= /ye shes= /ye shes rgyal po phyag 'tshal bstod/ khyod kyi go 'phang mnyam med pa/ /bdag la de ring gnang bar gsol/ /lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas/ slob ma rnams pad nyi la baṃ las rdo rje rnal 'byor mar/ bsgoms pa nas/ rigs bdag gi dbu rgyan pa'i bar mngon rtogs ltar ram/ de tsam mi nus na/ go cha 'god pa dang*/ ye shes pa gzhug pa bor kyang chog gsung*/ 'on kyang gzhung gi dngos bstan ni/ lhar bskyed dbang bskur go cha sa bon tsam gyi 'god pa yin no/ / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra swabhā ba atma ko3haṃ/ bum pa'i dbang ngo*/ /slob dpon dang dbyer med pa'i sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa' 'am/ he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ byang sems dkar dmar lce thog tu myangs par bsam la sbyin cing btung*/ bdud rtsi de nyid lte ba'i baṃ la thim/ de las me 'bar spyi bo'i haṃ zhu ba'i bde ba la mnyam par 'jog /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka badzra swa bhā wa wātma ko3haṃ/ gsang dbang ngo*/ / slob ma he ru ka'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpar sgyur gsung*/ bud med gzugs ni spangs nas gzhan/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs su bya/ /nu ma spangs pa bo lar gyur/ /lhag ma bdag nyid chen po nyid/ / 'di'i nges pa las lha mo'i mtshan rnams bsgyur gyi phyag mtshan sogs mi bsgyur bar bzhed kyin snang bas gang mos so/ /de nas phyag rgya mtshan nyid rdzogs pa gtad la/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ lha mo 'di ni khyod dang mthun/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags/ /gnyis su med dang bdag med pa'i/ /'dod pa lnga la spyad par gyis/ / zhes brjod de/ de rdo rje phag mor gyur/ snyoms par zhugs/ lha mo dam 'khyud tsum pa na/

/rnal 'byor gsal pa'i rnam shes so/ / 'dod bcas sbyor ba gnyis pa ni/ /rjes su rnal 'byor yin par 'dod/ /rtsol bral shin tu rnal 'byor ni/ /lhag pa'i bde ba gsum pa'o/ /rnal 'byor chen po gsum las gzhan/ /mtshan nyid bral ba'i skad cig ma'o/ /sbyor dang 'dzag dang lhung ba las/ /skad cig bzhi bo mthong zhes gsung*/ /bde ba'i nyams myong dran par byas te mnyam par bzhag / gnas bzhir dkyil 'khor gyis sindhru ra'i thig le bya/ oṃ āḥhūṃ āṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swabha wā wātma ko3haṃ/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*/ /de nas lus gnad bcas dbugs phyir dbyung*/ rang rdo rje sems dpa' kha sbyor sgyu ma lta bu/ rlung nang du rngub/ de nyid mtha' nas dbus su yal ba la dmigs med du mnyam par bzhag /de nas bde stong dbyer med de nyid lha skur ldang*/ sdug ma nam mkha'i nor bu dang*/ /'dus byas spros pa kun zlog kyang*/ /de ni rgya chen yid la byed/ / ā ho 'od gsal mdzes ma'o/ /shes rab mdzes ma la chags sbyor ba yis/ / 'dus byas 'dus ma byas pa las grol ba/ /bskal ba'am bskal pa stong gi bar du yang*/ /ye shes 'di sbyor sgrub pas gnas par byos/ /a re a re ā ho/ dbang bzhi pa'o/ / gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ maṇḍal 'bul/ de nas spyi ltar/ deng nas brtsams te sogs bya ste bod snga ma'i phyag len ltar rung ngo*/ /bla ma rgya gar ba'i phyag bzhes ni/ maṇḍal dang yon phul te/ deng du bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /de ring gson pa'ang 'bras bur bcas/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su bdag deng gyur/ / zhes slob mas rjes zlos byed pa'o/ /rjes kyi bya ba ni sngar mchod pa'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /lugs 'di la nyal ba dang*/ ldang ba dang zas kyi rnal 'byor la sogs pa ni khyad par zur pa med pas ma spros so/ /spyir 'di'i gzhung ni zab don rim gnyis kho na las 'phros pa'i rim pa cher ma bshad pa/

bla ma'i man ngag gis rgyas par bstan pa de dag go /byin rlabs kyi cho ga ni rtsen mas kha bskangs pa'ang mdzad mod kyi gzhung gi dngos bstan 'di kho na legs pa yin no/ /go don ni gzhung gi steng du rtogs par bya'o/ /gang zhig mtha' la mi gnas dbu mar gshegs/ /'gro 'ong med las srid pa'i gnas kun tu/ /dmigs med thugs rjes sems can ma dmigs kyang*/ / 'gro kun sgrol mdzad 'di ni ya mtshan rmad/ /de 'dra'i rje btsun bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ /'di na man ngag ldan par rab sbyar yang*/ /byis pa'i blo ni don la rnam par 'khor/ /de bas 'khrul na dam pa rnams bzod mdzod/ /kun dga' snying pos 'dir ni rnam phye ba'i/ /dge ba gang yin de yang nga rgyal med/ /gal te yod na'ang 'gro kun thar bar shog /'di dag gis kyang don mchog mi 'gyur ram// // zhes pa rngon pa'i gdams ngag las 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs bde ba sbyin pa zhes bya ba 'di ni dpal stag lung thang pa rje btsun bla ma don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ mi 'phrog pa'i thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis kyi bka' stsal spyi bos nod te tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gsum la sbyar ba'o/ /zhus dag /maṅga laṃ bī pū laṃ/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rje btsun rngon pa'i gdams ngag las 'byung ba'i rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ - PAGE 118 -- PAGE 119 -- PAGE 100 -
